steps.prompt: A small outdoor skate-park spectator grandstand: four tiers of aluminium bench seats on a painted plum steel frame with stairs, topped by a curved tensioned fabric sun-sail canopy in coral and sunshine yellow on steel masts. Photoreal studio product photograph of a premium toy-grade scale model, glossy automotive clearcoat paint, real rubber, brushed and chromed metal, real fabric, fine surface detail and light wear, saturated street-art colours. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
